prompt:
Use-case: background-extraction plus explicitly requested construction-stage editing.
Reference1 is the EDIT TARGET crop of our project-owned lower-frontal town study. Reference2 is the complete OWN composition guide: only camera, depth, light and material authority, NOT a scene to reproduce. Reference3 is the PRIVATE official Demacia crest shape: redraw on existing small blue cloth where requested, no imported original pixels.
Make ONE complete connected town-building construction object only. Preserve the target architectural family's lower frontal perspective and scene depth, upper-left light, richly textured painted/prerendered original-Heroes-III material language, weathered pale petricite, muted blue-gray slate/blue cloth, dark openings, steel and restrained old gold. Follow the exact specified state geometry, simpler foundations for early states and real structural improvements for upgrades. One visible state replaces its predecessor at SAME site. No high isometric dollhouse camera, glossy contemporary3D, anime, vector art, mobile proportions or League splash composition.
TRUE transparent RGBA background, entire silhouette with modest transparent margins, only thin integral threshold/plinth and short soft alpha contact shadow. Remove ALL unrelated buildings, roads, terraces, cliff/grass rectangles, sky, water, landscape, shrubs and trees. Reconstruct obscured/cropped edges consistently. No people/crowds, labels/text/UI/frame, fake checkerboard or opaque background. Broad forms must read at actual native size; do not add tiny pointless clutter. Exact crest is upright central pointed blade/leaf, paired mirrored feather wings and tapered lower stem, NOT trident or fleur-de-lis. Do not add duplicate independent functional lots.

Assigned native site box: [350, 10, 219, 151] on800x374canvas.

No large dome, guardian statues or rotunda towers. Roughly60percent of eventual Capitol height and70percent width, generous transparent margins.
